title: Bounded-above flat complexes are K-flat in a monoidal abelian category
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with a monoidal structure [def-sfb-monoidal-category] whose tensor product is additive in both variables. Assume countable coproducts and $\mathbf Z$-indexed colimits exist [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], the latter preserve short exact sequences, and tensoring on either side with a fixed object preserves both sorts of colimit. Here $\mathbf Z$ is ordered by $\le$. Call an object $F$ flat if $F\otimes-$ and $-\otimes F$ preserve short exact sequences. Let $E$ be a cochain complex [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with $E^i=0$ for all $i>b$ for some integer $b$, and suppose every $E^i$ is flat. Then $E$ is K-flat for the two-sided direct-sum total tensor product [def-sfb-preserves-kflat-quasi-iso].
